html.，以1–100展示。R增大经验较少车手的年度变化方差，允许更快上升或回落；M把个: , displayed on a 1–100 scale. R increases season-level change variance for less-experienced drivers, allowing faster rises or falls. M shortens the half-life of the individual qualifying-result average to three months, while reliability still uses one year. The composite rating includes full-field results; it is not a pure measure of pace in equal machinery.
html.圆点为各站排位前的历史快照，不含该站排位结果；最新菱形含2026 R14结果，截: Circles are historical snapshots before each qualifying session and exclude that session’s result. The latest diamonds include 2026 R14, with a cutoff of 2026-09-25 11:00 UTC. Ratings come from event-by-event historical replay, not predictions recorded live at the time. This page does not update automatically.
html.“两次均线”先对原始评分做第一次后向均值，再对其结果做第二次后向均值。两个窗口可: “Two-pass SMA” first computes a trailing simple moving average of the raw ratings, then averages that result again. Set each window independently; defaults are 3 / 3, and 1 skips a pass. Each driver is calculated separately using only the current and earlier saved points. Short initial windows use the available points; years and zoom changes do not reset the calculation, and absences are not filled. Larger windows are smoother but more delayed. The latest diamond also enters the average. Tooltips, the table and CSV retain raw scores.
html.首次显示常用8位车手的2025–2026轨迹；可选择“全部”查看2010起历史，: The initial view shows the usual eight drivers in 2025–2026. Choose “All years” for history from 2010, or “ANT / RUS · 2026” for that pairing. Dotted lines mark parameter transitions between consecutive seasons; lines do not bridge absences. A driver’s last available snapshot is not a final post-retirement assessment.
html.2010–2015按赛事顺序回顾重建，日期不代表已核实的实际排位时刻。2010前: 2010–2015 is reconstructed retrospectively in event order; dates are not verified actual qualifying times. Results before 2010 are excluded, so early drivers start from a neutral prior. These curves should not be treated as an unconditional all-time ranking.
html.RM是供讨论的研究版本：2017–2022为验证期，2023–2026为已见回放: RM is a research version for discussion: 2017–2022 is validation, and 2023–2026 is already-seen replay. It has not replaced the package’s selected m1r1 model. Greater rookie volatility and mixed predictive results remain limitations. A smoother curve does not mean a more accurate forecast.
html.。本项目整理身份、重建历史信息边界并计算派生评分；这些分数不是F1DB原始输出，: . This project reconciles identities, reconstructs historical information cutoffs and calculates derived ratings. These ratings are not original F1DB outputs and do not imply its endorsement. This project is independent of F1 and the FIA.
